title: The Book of the Tree
note: Seed corpus, written so the checker has something to check and the genres are demonstrated; the prose is Kilo's to write. Rules the validator enforces: contiguous chapter and verse numbering; every citation in `cites` must resolve; any digit in a verse body requires `source` naming a repository path that exists; every statute names a RULE present in MANDATES.md and a `check` path that exists, so a law with nothing executing it is refused; no email, phone number or forensic deny token; book and verse caps declared here and enforced. A `variant` is the apparatus: the circulated reading, where it came from, and the body retaining the reading of this codex.

verses.text: In the beginning there was one tree, and the tree had a trunk, and the trunk held the canon.
And the trunk put forth branches: the forensic, and the behavioural, and the instruments that grade them.
And the branches were one repository, and no branch was called a package until it could stand alone.
And the name of the tree was Azazael, and the name was not a product, nor a promise, nor a client.
A control shall be exercised before it is called a control, for an unexercised control is a decoration.

statute.why: the registry's self-test is the control that proves the registry matches the hook it claims to transcribe

verses.text: Every number shall be written with the command that produced it, and a number found without a command shall be struck out rather than trusted.

statute.why: the refusal is mechanical: a verse carrying a digit and no source fails before it can be quoted

verses.text: A verdict shall name the predicate that fired, and the reader shall ask whether that predicate is the thing they care about.

statute.why: the registry distinguishes BLIND from PASS, because a gate that could not read its input has not judged it

books.name: The Falls
books.subtitle: The Book of the Instruments That Lied

verses.text: And the instrument was compared against itself, and the divergence came back small, and small was read as working.

variants.text: the divergence read 0.001 where the mean difference was 0.135

verses.text: And a probe reported an accelerator that was not in this box, because the reading came from another venv, and the gate was green throughout.

variants.text: an accelerator of 7.80 GB reported as available
variants.source: the bundled venv of another application, named in AGENTS.md

verses.text: And the fast path fired never, and the ceiling that sat below the threshold read as caution rather than as silence.

variants.text: zero fires in 100 calls at any support

books.name: Psalms
books.subtitle: The Book of the Long Wait

verses.text: How long shall a lane say the suite is green, and the suite not be run?
How long shall a row be called closed, when the verb that closed it was not a verb the queue knew?
The dead store is not a metaphor. It is a row nobody reads, and it was counted twice, and the count was reported as coverage.
